source.title: USMLE Step 1 Sample Test Questions
source.verificationMethod: Official PDF text opened through search_service_web_run. Every row was independently transcribed before reading the dataset; exact conventional and SI comparisons then completed.
source.visualLimitation: Screenshot calls returned only <<ImageDisplayed>> placeholders without image bytes. No visual inspection is claimed. Superscripts and table columns were verified from the extracted text, units, and row alignment.

methodNotes: Independent numerical source matrix: official-ranges.tsv. All 114 conventional/SI pairs compared after typography-only Unicode normalization. No conversion, rounding, inequality, or cutoff normalization applied.
Names, subgroup inheritance, fasting/random states, sex, menopausal phase, cortisol times, stimulation status, arterial room-air conditions, 24-hour units, and specimen groups read individually.
The source has no SI entry for adult BMI; null is preserved rather than inventing a value. Source classifications and ranges remain the USMLE reference, not substituted local diagnostic thresholds.
AI review only; no human medical approval is represented.
